name: Airbnb
outlook:
What Airbnb says to expect

  • Fourth quarter 2026: revenueWe expect to generate revenue of $3.22 billion to $3.28 billion, representing year-over-year growth of 16% to 18%, inclusive of an approximate two percentage point FX tailwind after factoring in our hedging program.
  • Full year 2026: revenue growthFor full-year 2026, we now expect year-over-year revenue growth in the high teens, as execution across our product roadmap and resilient travel demand continues to drive growth across our business.
  • Full year 2026: Adjusted EBITDA MarginFor full-year 2026, we now expect Adjusted EBITDA Margin to increase to approximately 36%, reflecting year-over-year margin expansion driven by stronger top-line growth and underlying operating leverage in our core business, while we continue to invest in opportunities to drive sustainable growth.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 5, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
